nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a field, $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and $R = K[x_1, \dots, x_n]$, and let $M$ be an $R$-module that is also a $K$-vector space. A $\mathbb{Z}^n$-grading of $M$ compatible with monomial multiplication consists of $K$-subspaces $M_\alpha \subseteq M$, one for each $\alpha \in \mathbb{Z}^n$, such that $M$ is the direct sum of the $M_\alpha$, the action of each $k \in K$ on $M$ agrees with multiplication by the…
nodes.title: Multigraded modules over a polynomial ring

nodes.summary: For an exponent vector $a = (a_1, \dots, a_n) \in \mathbb{N}^n$ of a monomial, this is the vector $(a_1, \dots, a_n) \in \mathbb{Z}^n$ obtained by viewing each entry $a_i$ as an integer.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
